test_coverage_notes: EscrowFinish transaction logic is typically tested in unit/integration tests under the transaction suite, e.g., 'test/tx/Escrow_test.cpp', 'test/tx/EscrowFinish_test.cpp', or similar. These tests usually cover: (1) presence/absence of sfCondition/sfFulfillment, (2) valid/invalid condition/fulfillment pairs, (3) credential field validation, (4) feature flag gating. Gaps may exist in edge cases for malformed credential fields, rare cryptographic condition types, or feature-flag transitions. Direct tests for credential feature gating may be limited if featureCredentials is new or experimental.
